title: 18-year-old college student dies after jumping out of moving vehicle, police say
text:
ALBANY, Ga. (WALB/Gray News) — Georgia authorities are investigating the death of an Albany State University student.

According to the county coroner, the 18-year-old died after jumping out of a moving vehicle on Newton Road around 1:30 a.m. Friday.

The Albany Police Department and other agencies are investigating the situation.

Further details were not immediately available. Authorities said the student’s death remains under investigation.
